messages:
maria: Quick check 1: compact reorder ghost sometimes hides drop targets; preview heatmap also clips on narrow panes. Can we triage?
charlie: Repro'd. Ghost overlaps target by ~5-7px in condensed lists. Likely transform offset.
anya: I see it too. Placeholder height calc wrong when condensed.
kevin: Short fix: switch dragged element to absolute positioning during drag so hitbox matches visual. Or toggle pointer-events on ghost. Prefer absolute.
charlie: Visual tweak: ghost opacity 0.75 + dashed 1px placeholder outline so you can always see the anchor.
maria: Copy nit for empty sim: change "No matching routes found" -> "No active routing rules match this input yet."
lydia: A11y: SR announces "dragging" but not new position. Add aria-live polite announcement on drop: "Rule X moved to position 2." Also ensure keyboard reorder focuses placeholder.
anya: I'll open a PR for absolute-drag + aria-live updates and keyboard focus today.
kevin: I'll re-anchor validation toasts to the rules panel (avoid overlapping sim) and make legend collapsible under 720px to prevent clipping.
ux-bot: Checklist: add unit test for placeholder calc, add A11y checklist item for reordering. :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks 12. Land copy + small fixes next sprint?
